name: LogLaplace

args.name: lm
args.description: The location of the distribution of log(X)

args.name: ls
args.description: The scale of the distribution of log(X)

title: The log-Laplace distribution
description: For X drawn from LogLaplace(lm,ls), log(X) has a Laplace distribution with location lm and scale ls. Thus X > 0 and its median is exp(lm).
